runtime.mail_client: Amail on Windows, macOS, and Linux, or NOVA, Grok Bot, or another compatible client. No installer is shipped here.

polling.note: A polling reconciler exists only after an explicit owner approval recorded outside the agent.

alternatives.flow: SES receipt writes S3, SNS notifies, a queue or Cloudflare Worker wakes the role agent with the object reference
A coordinator webhook receives one notification and fans out object references to role agents
A direct webhook may be configured and dormant while a peer performs the actual wake

sender.note: Class allowlists are examples. A live IAM condition is unverified until that policy can be read. This file does not authorize SES and it does not publish DNS.

optional_hosts: Any HTTPS origin, including optional object storage such as R2 or S3 behind a public hostname

optional_components.cloudflare_dns: Can publish SES MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC. Does not receive SES mail.
optional_components.cloudflare_email_routing: Alternate ingress. Not combined with SES MX on the same hostname.
optional_components.cloudflare_r2_artwork: Optional public asset host. Not required.
optional_components.cloudflare_access_crm: Optional protection in front of a CRM API. Not required and not mail ingress.
